title: Iowa public television, the 40th anniversary film and Carnegie Hall concert
summary: He praises the Iowa public television crew, the 90-minute 40th anniversary film, and the sold-out Carnegie Hall alumni concert recorded for RCA Victor.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: I see. And then you've had some national public television special things.
Yeah, we do some of that. And it's usually done by the same people, in Des Moines, Iowa.

Which is connected basically -- it's the state of Iowa public television center. And it's one of the best crews and has some of the best equipment I've ever seen. And it's been a great joy and a pleasure to do shows in there.
Now, they documented a kind of mini-history
Yeah, they did a 40th anniversary film, it was a 90-minute show, and I'm very proud of that. That's one of the best things I was ever involved in.
Uh-huh. Your 40th anniversary had a lot of attention. It was a true milestone, and your concert at Carnegie Hall brought a lot of your alumni together.

That's true. And the fact that we had people from all over America and Europe attend this festive meeting of the ways, I was very -- it reinstated once again my faith in what we're trying to do, and I think it was an extremely successful night, and I think that the album on RCA Victor proves that we were there in the state we should have been. But I think the fact that we were able to sell out a few hours before the concert started gave me reassurance that all is well.
